d: A storm delivers deadly driving conditions as the truckers struggle to deliver their loads.
Darrell and Todd try to get through record-breaking snowfall, while the rest of the team fights to survive  despite frigid temperatures the war between VP Express and Polar reaches a boiling point.
The truckers battle a massive storm.
Hugh has a plan to crush the competition  Todd and Lisa are pressured to up their game.

With temperatures on the rise, conditions on the ice roads result in meltdown. The truckers from Polar and VP Express are pushed to the limit, crossing thin ice on their way to deliver critical loads.
Lisa and Todd take on one of the toughest runs of the season  Darrell steals business from his former boss  Alex's trucking season is threatened by a crash.
Darrell's calls in a surprising reinforcement  but can this new team member hack the treacherous ice roads  Hugh has a brush with near disaster.
